The '''Teepo Paladins''' were a small group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] who followed the teachings of [[Teepo]] and believed that the use of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and other weapons in addition to [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] was acceptable. Because of this, the Teepos were censured by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] an unspecified number of years prior to the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. The Teepos wore masks and other sensory-depriving devices when they engaged in combat as a means of increasing their connection with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Teepo Paladins who held more radical views eventually formed their own faction, the [[Gray Paladin]]s.

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]'' was the first official source to describe the Teepo Paladins and their background. However, they were created by fan, Peter Skanes, and collected in an [[Fanon|unofficial fan-made]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|Star Wars roleplaying game]] called "The Jedi Handbook".<ref name="Jedi Handbook">{{WebCite|url=http://mama.indstate.edu/rpg/games/weg/starwars/web15.htm#PartVII|text="Part VII: Teepo Paladins: Quick Draw Jedi", The Jedi Handbook|archivedate=20060712214250|nolive=1}}</ref>
